changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwappointmentreschedule AS SELECT ar.id, ar.old_appointment_id, ar.new_appointment_id, ar.reschedule_reason, ar.created_by, ar.created_date FROM public.appointment_reschedule ar;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentreschedule TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwappointmentreschedule FROM report_user;
